digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflow and pytest test selection
propositions: 19 identified repository-policy assertions that inspect only immutable repository text/AST are redundantly executed in all four default-suite matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13)
OS/Python-invariant policy tests should execute exactly once in the Ubuntu 3.13 default-suite process rather than four times across all matrix cells
